reasons: The RFP is for physical janitorial and custodial services across 148,000 square feet (page 3), which completely falls outside our core capabilities as an AI-native engineering studio.
Bidders must demonstrate at least five years of continuous experience providing commercial janitorial services (page 7), which is completely unrelated to our engineering domain.
Bidders must currently service at least three facilities of 25,000 square feet or more with commercial cleaning references (page 7).
summary: Larkspur County is soliciting proposals for RFP No. LC-FM-2027-03 for nightly cleaning, day porter service, and periodic floor care across five facilities totaling 148,000 sq. ft.
Attendance at the pre-bid meeting and site walk on December 3, 2026, at 9:00 AM is mandatory, with non-attendees rejected as non-responsive.
Sealed proposals are due by December 15, 2026, at 2:00 PM Eastern, and the contract term runs from February 1, 2027, through January 31, 2029, with two optional one-year renewals.
Bidders must submit bid bonds, pass background checks, meet minimum labor hour commitments, and pay employees a living wage of at least $17.25/hr.
